info.name: Potion Express
info.description: Deliver potions across the map, outbluffing and outwitting your rival witches along the way!
info.attribution:
Game layout, library image, and scripting by Robin Harn, released to the Public Domain under CC0.

Game board, potion and magic wand images by couchlife, released to the Public Domain under CC0.

All card icons are from https://game-icons.net and are used under CC BY 3.0.

1.event: Each player chooses to play 1/2/3/4/5 cards and receives +10/+6/+3/0/-3 points for them.

2.event: Leader of each trick must play brave. First player of the round gets +1 wand.

3.event: If choosing cowardly, players may take +3 VPs instead of performing the cowardly action.

4.event: Do a sealed blind bid of any number of resources. Winner loses them and receives +8 VPs.

5.event: At end of round, each player may return a full set of resources for +9 VPs.

6.event: If choosing cowardly, players may take 1 resource instead of performing the cowardly action.

7.event:
Earn VPs at end of round based on pawn locations: 
      
Hills +1, Prairie +2, Mountain -1

8.event: Each player with 5 or fewer resources at end of round gets +3 VPs.

9.event: If both pawns owned by a player are in the same type of region at end of round, gain +4 VPs.

10.event:
Lose VPs at end of round based on pawn locations:
      
Hills -2, Prairie -3, Forest -1
